lines.l: But now you've found another partner, you left me like a broken tar.
It's someone else you're taking, someone else you're playing to.
Honey, though I make it, you're just what I have to do.
If I can have you when I'm wakin', I'll go to sleep and dream I'm with you
Oh, take me, take me, take me to the dreamer's bar
I'll be right on time, and I'll dress so fine
You're gonna love me when you see me, I won't have to worry.
Take me, take me, promise not to wake me till it's morning.
It's all been true.
What'd you say about that hammer?
You're gonna take me to that previous ball.
I'd like that.
Oh, take me, take me, take me, I'm your playing thing now.
Make my life worthwhile
With the slightest smile
Or destroy me with a penny
Perceptible whisper
Chantily take me
Remember I'll be dreaming of my baby
At the dreamer's bar
Oh, take me, hold me
Remember what you told me
He'd meet me at the dreamers' bar
I'd meet you at the dreamers' bar
U-Radio
